paragraphs: Google is going to court in Ireland. It wants to stop a big fine of €403 million.
The fine came from the Data Protection Commission, or DPC. This office protects people's personal data in Ireland. In September, it said Google broke EU data rules.
The DPC said Google used people's location data in the wrong way. Location data shows where a person goes. Google also kept this data for too long.
The DPC told Google to fix the problems in six months. Google says the decision is wrong. It says the changes would cost a lot of money.
On Monday, a judge moved the case to a faster court list. The case will come back later.
sentZh: Google正在愛爾蘭打官司。
它想阻止一筆4億300萬歐元的巨額罰款。
這筆罰款來自資料保護委員會，簡稱DPC。
這個機構保護愛爾蘭人民的個人資料。
九月時，它表示Google違反了歐盟的資料規定。
DPC說Google以錯誤的方式使用人們的位置資料。
位置資料會顯示一個人去了哪裡。
Google也把這些資料保存太久。
DPC要求Google在六個月內解決問題。
Google說這個決定是錯的。
它說這些改變會花很多錢。
週一，一名法官把此案移到較快的法院案件表。
此案稍後將再次審理。

paragraphs: Google has gone to the High Court in Dublin to challenge a fine of €403 million. The fine was given by the Data Protection Commission (DPC), the Irish office that makes sure companies follow EU privacy rules.

In September, the DPC said Google Ireland had broken the rules in eight ways. The problems were about how Google used location data, which shows where people go with their phones. The DPC said Google used this data together with people's web and app activity without a proper legal reason. It also said the company kept the data for longer than it needed.
As well as the fines, the DPC gave Google a formal warning. It ordered the company to fix its systems within six months.

Google wants the court to cancel all or part of the decision. It says the DPC made mistakes about the law and the facts. A senior Google manager said that making the changes would be difficult and very expensive. Google also plans to question parts of Ireland's data protection law.
On Monday, a judge agreed to put the case on the Commercial Court's fast list. The DPC did not object. The case will be heard at a later date.
